onboarding.title: Open your restaurant on FoodFen
onboarding.pitch: Put your dishes in front of diners who are looking for food that fits their nutrition goals.

free.title: Free to register
free.body: Create your restaurant profile and menu at no cost.

reach.title: Reach the right diners
reach.body: Your dishes appear in the Dishes tab of the FoodFen app, shown to people whose daily goals they fit.

directions.title: Easy directions
directions.body: Diners see your address and can open directions in Google Maps.

ads.title: Optional advertising
ads.body: You can buy a package to appear in the Sponsored section.

impressions.title: Track impressions
impressions.body: See how many times your restaurant was shown each day.

profile.title: Create your profile
profile.body: Add your name, address, coordinates, opening hours and a photo.

menu.title: Add your menu
menu.body: Enter the nutrition per serving for every dish: kcal, protein, carbs and fat.

review.title: FoodFen reviews it
review.body: We check your restaurant and each dish.

live.title: Go live in the app
live.body: Approved dishes are shown to diners.

items.accuracy: Nutrition per serving (kcal, protein, carbs, fat) must be accurate.
items.images: Restaurant and dish images may only be added through FoodFen's upload.
items.dishReview: When you edit a dish, it goes back to review and stays hidden until it is approved again.
items.profileEdits: Edits to the profile of an approved restaurant go live straight away, without a new review.
items.takedown: FoodFen can take down a restaurant or a dish at any time and will give a reason.
items.oneRestaurant: Each account can register one restaurant.
items.ads: Paid placement only shows a dish to diners it fits. If your restaurant is taken down while a package is running, the package is not refunded.

onboarding.accept: I have read and agree to the terms

myRestaurant.title: My restaurant
myRestaurant.pitch: List your dishes with their nutrition so FoodFen diners can find your restaurant. Registration is free.

register.title: Register your restaurant
register.hint: Free. Your restaurant goes live once FoodFen has reviewed your profile and menu.
